Here’s a structured 12-week program starting 2026-06-01 for your 47-year-old advanced lifter in early perimenopause, incorporating resistance training focus, heat/vasomotor symptom management, and recovery strategies aligned with her constraints. It uses a 3-days-on-lift/1-day-mobility optional/1-day-conditioning-light model, with built-in autoregulation for cycle variability and symptom flare days. Emphasis is on bone loading, strength, muscle retention, and thermoregulation.

Overview
- Duration: 12 weeks, 3 phases
  - Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Rebuild strength foundation, skill practice at higher intensities, strict cooling protocols
  - Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Intensification + hypertrophy density; maintain bone-loading; conditioning steady and cool
  - Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Peak strength and power emphasis, then deload and consolidation
- Weekly schedule template (adjust days as needed):
  - Mon: Lower A (strength)
  - Tue: Upper A (strength)
  - Wed: Mobility/Recovery (optional; no heat exposure)
  - Thu: Lower B (hypertrophy)
  - Fri: Upper B (hypertrophy)
  - Sat: Conditioning (low-impact, cool environment) + core
  - Sun: Full rest
- Environment and Cooling (strict throughout):
  - Train in a cool, well-ventilated space (ideally 18–21°C). Use fans aimed at neck/face and a cooling towel.
  - Pre-cooling: 15–20 min before sessions, sip cool or iced fluids; apply cool pack to back of neck for 5–10 min.
  - Intra: Cool fluids every 10–15 min; micro-rests if hot flash starts; prioritize shaded/AC area.
  - Post: Cool-down walk 5–8 min; cold drink; cool pack to neck/chest for 5–10 min.
  - Avoid sauna and high-heat environments. No fasted HIIT in heat.
- Autoregulation rules:
  - Use RPE and symptom flags. If hot flashes spike or heat intolerance rises mid-session:
    - Drop 1–2 sets from remaining exercises and extend rest to 2–3 min.
    - Reduce loads by ~5–10% while keeping form pristine.
  - During heavy bleeding or low-sleep nights: cap at RPE 7–8 and skip last accessory on each day.
- Intensity/Volume guide by phase:
  - Phase 1: Main lifts 70–82.5% 1RM, RPE 6–8; total hard sets 12–16 per session
  - Phase 2: Main lifts 72.5–87.5% 1RM, RPE 7–9; total hard sets 14–18 per session
  - Phase 3: Main lifts 75–90% 1RM, RPE 7–9; peaking with low reps; deload week lowers to 55–70%
- Rest periods:
  - Strength sets 2–3 min (up to 4 min on top sets if symptoms controlled)
  - Hypertrophy 60–90 s (extend to 2 min if heat symptoms present)
- Cardio/conditioning:
  - Steady-state, low-impact (bike, treadmill incline walk, rower) in cool environment. Zone 2–low Zone 3.
  - No hot environments. No intervals > Zone 3; use cadence changes instead of sprints if needed.

Warm-up (every session)
- 5–8 min brisk walk/airdyne in cool air with fan
- Dynamic mobility: ankle rocks, 90/90 hip switches, T-spine openers (2 sets x 6–8 each)
- Movement prep: glute bridge or hip airplane, scap push-up, dead bug (2x8 each)
- Specific warm-up sets: ramp 3–5 sets to working weight; keep body temp managed with fans

Core frequency
- 2–3 sessions/week: anti-extension, anti-rotation, loaded carries

Nutrition and hydration (global)
- Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day across 3–4 meals; include 30–40 g protein within 1–2 h post-lift
- Carbs: 3–5 g/kg/day baseline; on heavy lower days 4–6 g/kg; pre-lift 30–60 g low-GI carb + 15–25 g protein 60–120 min pre
- Fats: balance remainder; don’t reduce below ~0.8 g/kg on low-carb days
- Hydration: 30–40 ml/kg/day. Pre-lift 500 ml cool fluids; intra 150–250 ml every 10–15 min. If very salty sweater, add 300–500 mg sodium pre and 250–500 mg over session.
- Perimenopause support (food-first): prioritize calcium 1200 mg/day, vitamin D3 1500–2000 IU/day (or as per labs), magnesium glycinate 200–400 mg at night, omega-3 (EPA/DHA 1–2 g/day), phytoestrogen foods (soy, flax, legumes) if tolerated.
- Caffeine: limit to ≤200 mg pre-lift; avoid in late afternoon to protect sleep, which reduces vasomotor frequency/intensity.

Recovery and sleep
- Aim 7.5–9 h; cool bedroom (16–19°C), breathable bedding, light pajamas.
- Post-evening training: finish at least 3 h before bed; after shower, use lukewarm water to avoid rebound flushing.

Here’s a perimenopause- and bone-health–focused nutrition plan to layer onto the 12-week program. It emphasizes protein distribution, calcium/vitamin D, iron-conscious planning around irregular cycles, hydration/electrolytes for vasomotor symptoms, and practical meal structure. Primary goals
- Preserve/advance lean mass and strength
- Support bone mineral density
- Reduce vasomotor symptom triggers and protect sleep
- Maintain stable energy across irregular cycles

Daily macros and targets
- Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day, split over 3–5 feedings; aim 30–45 g high-quality protein per meal, 20–30 g at snacks
  - Include 2–3 leucine-rich feedings/day (e.g., 150–200 g Greek yogurt skyr; 120–180 g chicken/fish; 30–40 g whey)
- Carbohydrate: 3–6 g/kg/day, periodized to training
  - Lower range (3–4 g/kg) on lighter days; higher range (4–6 g/kg) on heavy lower-body days and when sleep is good
- Fat: remainder of calories, typically 0.8–1.0 g/kg/day
  - Favor mono- and omega-3 fats; limit saturated fats to <10% total kcal

Bone-health micronutrients (food first; confirm labs with GP)
- Calcium: 1200 mg/day from food + supplements if needed
  - Examples: dairy (milk, yogurt, kefir, cheese), calcium-fortified soy milk/juice, tofu set with calcium sulfate, canned salmon/sardines with bones, leafy greens (bok choy, kale), almonds
  - If short on intake, add 300–600 mg calcium citrate with meals (split doses)
- Vitamin D3: 1500–2000 IU/day (or per blood levels)
- Vitamin K: include leafy greens (vit K1) and fermented foods/eggs (vit K2)
- Magnesium: 200–400 mg magnesium glycinate at night (sleep and vasomotor support)
- Protein variety for bone: include dairy or soy protein (casein/soy isoflavones show bone benefits)
- Omega-3 (EPA+DHA): 1–2 g/day from fatty fish 2–3x/week or a purified fish oil supplement

Iron and B12 (irregular cycles)
- Iron: 18 mg/day baseline from food; increase attention during/after heavier bleeds
  - Sources: lean red meat 1–2x/week, mussels, clams, sardines, fortified cereals, legumes, tofu, pumpkin seeds, spinach
  - Pair plant iron with vitamin C (citrus, capsicum) and avoid taking iron with calcium/coffee/tea
  - If ferritin is low or symptoms suggest deficiency (fatigue, reduced performance), discuss labs and targeted supplementation with GP
- B12: ensure adequate intake (fish, dairy, eggs) or supplement if low/vegetarian

Hydration and vasomotor management
- Daily fluids: 30–40 ml/kg/day
- Pre-training: 500 ml cool/iced fluids 60–90 min prior
- Intra-training: 150–250 ml every 10–15 min; add electrolytes if heavy/salty sweater
  - Sodium: 300–500 mg pre + 250–500 mg during; consider low-sugar electrolyte mix
- Cooling sips: keep beverages cool; avoid very hot drinks during the day if they trigger flashes
- Alcohol: limit, as it may worsen hot flashes and sleep; if included, keep to ≤1 drink and not within 3–4 h of bedtime
- Caffeine: cap at ≤200 mg pre-lift, avoid after ~2 pm

- Identify triggers: spicy foods, high-sugar spikes, hot soups/beverages can worsen flashes in some—test and adjust

- Room temperature, hydration volume, hot flash events

  - Front Squat 3x3 @ RPE 8–8.5

  - Core: Hanging Leg Raise 3x8–10

  - OHP 4x2 @ 85%
  - DB Bench 3x6–8 @ 1–2 RIR
  - Wide Pulldown 3x8–10 @ 1–2 RIR
  - Lateral Raise 2–3x12–15; Cable Row 2–3x8–10; Arms 2 sets
  - Optional Z2 20–30 min easy if recovered
- Sat Cardio (cool, fan)
  - 40–45 min Z2 OR 30–35 min Z2 with 2 x 4 min low Z3 (RPE ~6.5), 3 min Z2 between
- Sun Rest or yoga/mobility

Week 6
- Mon Lower A (Heavier doubles)
  - Squat: top single @ RPE 8–8.5; 4x2 @ 86–88%
  - RDL 3x4–5 @ RPE 8.5
  - Hack/Press 2x8; Leg Curl 3x8–10; Calf 3x10–12; Ab Wheel 3x8–10
- Tue Upper A (Bench clusters)
  - Bench: top single @ RPE 8–8.5; 3 clusters of 2+2+1 @ ~87% (20–30 s intra; 3 min inter)
  - Weighted Chin-up 4x2–3 heavy
  - Incline DB 3x6–8; Row 3x6–8; Face Pull 2x12–15; Cable Chop 3x10/side
  - Optional HIIT (non-fasted, cool): Tempo–surge mix, total work 12–18 min, cap RPE 7–8
- Wed Mobility/Yoga (cool) 45–60 min
- Thu Lower B
  - Trap Bar DL 4x3 @ 85–87% (last set may be 2 reps if speed slows)
  - Front Squat 3x2–3 @ RPE 8.5
  - BSS 2x8/leg; Ham Curl 2–3x10; Calf 2–3x12; Hollow Rock 3x12–15
- Fri Upper B (Power option)
  - OHP 3x2 @ 86–88% or Push Press 4x2 @ RPE 8
  - DB Bench 3x6–8; Pulldown 3x8–10; Lateral Raise 2–3x12–15; Cable Row 2–3x8–10; Arms 2 sets
  - Optional Z2 20–30 min easy
- Sat Cardio
  - 45 min Z2; if recovered well, insert 3 x 3 min low Z3 with 3 min Z2 between
- Sun Rest or yoga/mobility

Week 7
- Mon Lower A (Peak doubles + light power)
  - Squat: top single @ RPE 8.5; 3x2 @ 88–89%
  - DB Jump Squat 3x4 (light; long rest; only if cool)
  - RDL 3x4 @ RPE 8–8.5; Leg Curl 2–3x8–10; Calf 2–3x10–12; Ab Wheel 3x6–8
- Tue Upper A (Heavy doubles)
  - Bench: top single @ RPE 8.5; 3x2 @ 88–89%
  - Med-ball Chest Pass 4x3 or Speed Bench 4x3 @ 60% (fast)
  - Weighted Chin-up 3x2–3; Row 3x6–8; Face Pull 2x12–15; Pallof 3x10/side
  - Optional HIIT (non-fasted, cool): 6 x 60 s @ RPE 7–8, 90 s easy
- Wed Mobility/Yoga (cool) 45–60 min
- Thu Lower B (Trap bar clusters)
  - Trap Bar DL: 3 clusters of 2+2 @ ~88% (30 s intra; 3 min inter)
  - Front Squat 3x2 @ RPE 8.5
  - Split Squat 2x6–8/leg; Ham Curl 2x10; Calf 2x12; Hanging Leg Raise 3x8–10
- Fri Upper B
  - OHP 3x2 @ 88–90% (RPE 8.5–9, crisp)
  - DB Bench 2–3x6–8; Pulldown 2–3x8–10; Lateral Raise 2x12–15; Cable Row 2x8–10
- Sat Cardio
  - 35–40 min Z2; optional 2 x 5 min low Z3 with 3–4 min Z2 between if recovered
- Sun Rest or yoga/mobility

Week 8 (Consolidate, prioritize quality over grinders)
- Mon Lower A
  - Squat: single @ RPE 8–8.5; 2–3x2 @ 88–90% (stop if speed drops >10%)
  - RDL 2–3x4 @ RPE 8; Leg Curl 2x8–10; Calf 2x10–12; Ab Wheel 2–3x6–8
- Tue Upper A
  - Bench: single @ RPE 8–8.5; 2–3x2 @ 88–90%
  - Speed OHP 3x2 @ 60–65% fast
  - Weighted Chin-up 2–3x2–3; Row 2–3x6–8
- Wed Mobility/Yoga (cool) 45–60 min
- Thu Lower B
  - Trap Bar DL 2–3x2 @ 88–90% (cap RPE ≤9)
  - Front Squat 2–3x2 @ RPE 8–8.5
  - Split Squat 2x6–8/leg
- Fri Upper B
  - OHP 2–3x2 @ 88–90% or Push Press 3x2 @ RPE 8.5
  - DB Bench 2x6–8; Pulldown 2x8–10
- Sat Cardio
  - 30–40 min Z2 only this week
- Sun Rest or yoga/mobility

Week 9
- Mon Lower A
  - Back Squat 5x2 @ 85–87.5% (RPE 8–9)
  - Speed Pull (trap bar) 5x2 @ ~60% fast
  - RDL 3x4; Leg Curl 3x8–10; Calf 3x12–15; Ab Wheel 3x8–10
- Tue Upper A
  - Bench 5x2 @ 85–87.5%
  - Speed OHP 5x2 @ 60% fast
  - Weighted Chin-up 4x3 heavy; Row 3x8–10; Face Pull 3x12–15; Pallof 3x10/side
- Wed Mobility/Yoga (cool) 30–45 min gentle
- Thu Lower B
  - Trap Bar DL 4x2 @ 85–87.5%; Front Squat 3x2 @ RPE 8
  - Split Squat 2x8/leg; Ham Curl 2x10; Calf 2x12–15; Hanging Leg Raise 3x8–10
- Fri Upper B
  - OHP 4x2 @ 85%; DB Bench 2x8–10; Pulldown 2x10; Cable Row 2x10
- Sat Cardio
  - 30–40 min Z2 (no tempo this week)
- Sun Rest

Week 10
- Mon Lower A: Squat 4x2 @ 87.5–90%; Speed Pull 4x2 @ 60%; RDL 3x3–4; Leg Curl 3x8–10; Ab Wheel 3x8–10
- Tue Upper A: Bench 4x2 @ 87.5–90%; Speed OHP 4x2 @ 60%; Weighted Chin-up 3x3; Row 3x8–10
- Wed Mobility/Yoga (cool) 30–45 min gentle
- Thu Lower B: Trap Bar DL 3x2 @ 87.5–90%; Front Squat 3x2 @ RPE 8–9; Split Squat 2x8/leg; Ham Curl 2x10
- Fri Upper B: OHP 3x2 @ 87.5%; DB Bench 2x8–10; Pulldown 2x10; Row 2x10
- Sat Cardio: 25–35 min Z2; optional 2–3 x 2 min low Z3 only if recovery excellent
- Sun Rest

Week 11
- Mon Lower A: Optional squat single @ RPE 8.5–9; then 3x2 @ 85%; RDL 2x3–4; Leg Curl 2x8–10; Ab Wheel 2–3x8
- Tue Upper A: Optional bench single @ RPE 8.5–9; then 3x2 @ 85%; Weighted Chin-up 3x2–3; Row 2x8–10
- Wed Mobility/Yoga (cool) 30–45 min gentle
- Thu Lower B: Trap Bar DL 2–3x2 @ 85–87.5%; Front Squat 2x2 @ RPE 8; Split Squat 2x6/leg; Ham Curl 2x8
- Fri Upper B: OHP 2–3x2 @ 85–87.5%; DB Bench 2x8; Pulldown 2x8–10
- Sat Cardio: 20–30 min easy Z2
- Sun Rest

Week 12 Deload (and optional 1RM testing)
- Default deload (if not testing)
  - Mon Lower A: Squat 3x3 @ 60–65%; RDL 2x6 light; Leg Curl 2x10; Calf 2x12; Core: Plank 2x30–45 s
  - Tue Upper A: Bench 3x3 @ 60–65%; Assisted Chin or light Pulldown 2x6–8; Row 2x10; Face Pull 2x12–15; Pallof 2x10/side
  - Thu Lower B: Trap Bar DL 3x2 @ 60–70%; Front Squat 2x3 light; Split Squat 2x6/leg
  - Fri Upper B: OHP 3x2 @ 60–70%; DB Bench 2x8 light; Pulldown 2x10 light
  - Sat Cardio: 20–30 min Z1–Z2 easy
  - Mobility/Yoga: 30–45 min gentle midweek
- Optional 1RM testing (if symptom-stable, cool room, spotters)
  - Day 1 (Mon or Tue): Test Back Squat then Bench
  - Day 2 (Thu or Fri): Test Trap Bar Deadlift then OHP
  - Warm-up ladder: bar x 5–8; 40% x 5; 55% x 3; 70% x 2; 80% x 1; 90–93% x 1; 95–97% x 1; attempt 1RM with 2.5–5 kg jumps based on bar speed
  - Attempt plan: A1 ~90–93% smooth; A2 96–100%; A3 101–103% only if A2 was fast and symptoms calm; cap RPE ≤9.5
  - If symptoms flare or room >22°C: switch to e1RM via single @ RPE 8–8.5 + back-off data
  - Strict cooling between attempts; hydrate and use neck cool pack 2–3 min as needed

Cardio detail by phase (overlay)
- Phase 1: 90–120 min/week Z2 across 2–3 sessions
  - Sat Z2 30–40 min; Tue/Fri optional Z2 20–30 min after upper days
- Phase 2: 100–130 min/week; 1 weekly low-Z3 insertion if recovered; HIIT optional 1x/week non-fasted in cool environment
  - Sat Z2 35–45 min (with 8–10 min low Z3 some weeks)
  - Tue or Fri optional Z2 20–30 min; HIIT template: 6–8 x 60 s @ RPE 7–8 with 90 s easy (or tempo–surge mix)
- Phase 3: 80–120 min/week; remove tempo in Weeks 9–11 heavy days; deload easy
  - Sat Z2 25–40 min; Tue optional Z2 15–25 min recovery
- Cardio guardrails: no fasted HIIT; stop or downgrade if hot flash intensity high or environment warm

Mobility/yoga sessions (use 1–2x/week)
- Option A: Cool-room Yoga Flow 45–60 min (breath + hip/T-spine/shoulder sequences; RPE ≤3–4)
- Option B: 20–30 min Mobility Circuit (hips CARs, 90/90 lift-offs, ankle dorsiflexion, T-spine windmills, wall slides, goblet squat ISO holds, Jefferson curl very light, 90/90 breathing)

Monitoring and contingencies
- Track per session: RPEs, bar speed/feel, hot flash intensity (0–10), sleep hours, room temp, hydration
- Heat wave: train in AC; cut conditioning duration by 25%; remove tempo/HIIT; emphasize fluids/electrolytes; use cold meals
- Heavy bleed/poor sleep: strength cap RPE 7–8; reduce accessories 25–50%; cardio Z1–Z2 only 15–25 min
- Progress markers (biweekly): fixed Z2 pace HR, resting HR trend, bar speed on prescribed intensities, calcium/protein compliance days, symptom diary

This integrated plan builds strength and muscle, maintains aerobic fitness, supports bone health and perimenopause needs, and protects against heat/vasomotor triggers—while giving you clear week-by-week structure, intensity progressions, cardio/HIIT placement, nutrition, mobility, and a safe testing pathway.

Here’s the complete 12-week program starting 2026-06-01, with all adjustments integrated: strength phases, intensified Phase 2, cardio to maintain/improve aerobic fitness, symptom-aware cooling, nutrition for perimenopause and bone health, mobility (cool-room yoga/mobility instead of hot yoga), HIIT guidelines (non-fasted, cool), and end-of-cycle 1RM testing protocol. The weekly structure can slide by a day as needed; keep heavy lower and HIIT separated. All sessions occur in cool, ventilated spaces (ideally 18–21°C) with fans and strict cooling.

Global structure
- Phases
  - Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Foundation strength, consistent Z2 cardio, strict cooling
  - Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Intensification with top singles/doubles and clusters; controlled low-Z3 cardio
  - Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Peak expression, protect recovery, deload Week 12; optional 1RM testing
- Weekly template
  - Mon: Lower A (strength)
  - Tue: Upper A (strength)
  - Wed: Mobility/Recovery (cool-room yoga or mobility)
  - Thu: Lower B (hypertrophy/strength)
  - Fri: Upper B (hypertrophy/strength)
  - Sat: Cardio Z2 (occasional low-Z3), core/carries
  - Sun: Rest or optional cool-room yoga/mobility
- Cooling and symptom management (every session)
  - Pre: 10–20 min pre-cool; sip cool/iced fluids; cool pack to neck 5–10 min
  - During: fans on face/neck; 150–250 ml cool fluids every 10–15 min; extend rests if heat builds
  - Post: 5–8 min easy cool-down + cool drink + cool pack 5–10 min
  - If hot flash: pause, cool 2–3 min; resume with 5–10% load drop and longer rests; second event—end heavy work
- Autoregulation
  - Cap to RPE 7–8 on poor-sleep or heavy-bleed days; drop 1–2 accessory sets
  - Room temp >22°C or symptom flare: reduce loads 5–10% and volume 25–40%

Nutrition and hydration (daily, for all phases)
- Protein 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day (evenly across 3–5 feedings; 30–45 g/meal)
- Carbs 3–6 g/kg/day (higher on heavy lower days; center around training)
- Fats 0.8–1.0 g/kg/day (mono-/omega-3 focus)
- Bone health: calcium 1200 mg/day, vitamin D3 1500–2000 IU/day (per labs), vitamin K via greens/ferments, magnesium glycinate 200–400 mg nightly, omega-3 (EPA/DHA) 1–2 g/day, dairy/fortified soy or calcium-set tofu
- Iron-aware on heavy bleeds; pair plant iron with vitamin C; check ferritin if fatigue
- Hydration: 30–40 ml/kg/day; pre-lift 500 ml; intra 150–250 ml/10–15 min; if salty sweater add 300–500 mg sodium pre + 250–500 mg during
- Pre-lift meal 60–120 min: 30–60 g carbs + 15–30 g protein; avoid very hot drinks
- Post-lift: 30–45 g protein + 60–90 g carbs (higher after heavy lower)
- Creatine 3–5 g/day; caffeine ≤200 mg pre, avoid after ~2 pm
- Phytoestrogen foods (soy, flax, legumes) if tolerated
- Modest deficit (250–400 kcal/day) only if fat loss is a goal and performance holds

Cardio and HIIT overview
- Z2 steady-state 2–3x/week total (primary Sat; optional Tue/Fri after upper days)
- Controlled low-Z3 tempo 1x/week in Phases 2–3 only if recovered and cool environment
- HIIT allowed only non-fasted in cool environment: 1x/week optional after an upper day or separate session; 12–18 min total work at RPE 7–8 using bike/rower/treadmill incline; never all-out sprints
- Autoregulate cardio: if sleep <6 h, room >22°C, or hot flashes ≥7/10 in last 24 h—Z1–Z2 only, shorten by 25–40%

Mobility and yoga
- No hot yoga. Use cool-room yoga (Hatha/Vinyasa) 45–60 min Wed and/or Sun, or 20–30 min mobility circuits (hips/T-spine/shoulders/ankles, isometrics, breath work)
- Hydrate with cool fluids; keep intensity low (RPE ≤3–4)

Core work
- 2–3x/week embedded: anti-extension (ab wheel, dead bug), anti-rotation (Pallof), carries (farmer/suitcase)

Phase 1: Weeks 1–4 (Foundation, Z2 base)
Week 1 (2026-06-01 to 2026-06-07)
- Mon Lower A
  - Back Squat 5x3 @ ~75% (RPE 7)
  - Romanian Deadlift 4x6 @ RPE 7
  - Walking Lunge 3x10/leg
  - Leg Curl 3x10–12
  - Standing Calf Raise 3x12–15
  - Core: Plank 3x45–60 s
- Tue Upper A
  - Bench Press 5x3 @ ~75% (RPE 7)
  - Weighted Chin-up 4x4–6 @ RPE 8 (or heavy pulldown)
  - Incline DB Press 3x8
  - One-arm DB Row 3x10/side
  - Face Pull 3x12–15
  - Core: Pallof Press 3x10/side
- Wed Mobility/Yoga (cool room, fans) 45–60 min easy flow or 20–30 min mobility circuit
- Thu Lower B
  - Trap Bar Deadlift 4x4 @ RPE 7–8
  - Front Squat 3x6 @ RPE 7
  - Bulgarian Split Squat 3x8/leg
  - Hamstring Slide 3x10–12
  - Seated Calf Raise 3x12–15
  - Core: Dead Bug 3x8/side
- Fri Upper B
  - Overhead Press 5x3 @ 72.5–75% (RPE 7)
  - Chest-supported Row 4x8
  - DB Bench 3x10
  - Lat Pulldown 3x10–12
  - Lateral Raise 3x12–15
  - Triceps Pressdown 2x12–15; DB Curl 2x10–12
  - Optional Z2: 20–25 min easy spin if recovered
- Sat Cardio + Core
  - Z2 30–35 min (bike or incline walk, fan)
  - Farmer Carry 4x40–60 m; Side Plank 3x30–45 s/side
- Sun Rest or easy cool-room yoga 30–45 min

Week 2
- Progress loads +2.5–5% if RPE ≤7 last set; else match Week 1
- Mon Lower A: Squat 5x3 @ 77.5%, RDL 4x6, Reverse Lunge 3x8/leg, Leg Curl 3x10–12, Calf 3x12–15, Copenhagen Plank 3x20–30 s/side

- Thu Lower B: Trap Bar DL 5x3 @ RPE 7–8, Front Squat 3x5, BSS 3x8/leg, Ham Slide 3x10–12, Calf 3x12–15, Hollow Rock 3x10–15
- Fri Upper B: OHP 5x3 @ 75–77.5%, Row 4x8, DB Bench 3x10, Pulldown 3x10–12, Lateral Raise 3x12–15, Arms 2–3 sets; optional Z2 25–30 min
- Sat Cardio Z2 30–35 min; Suitcase Carry 3x40 m/side + Bird Dog 3x8/side
- Sun Rest or yoga/mobility

Week 3
- If symptoms rise, keep Week 2 loads and drop one accessory set

- Fri Upper B: OHP 6x2 @ 77.5–80%; DB Bench 3x10; Seated Row 3x10; Pulldown 3x10–12; Lateral Raise 3x12–15; Arms 2–3 sets

Week 4

- Tue Upper A: Bench 5x2 @ 82.5%; Weighted Chin-up 4x3–5; Incline DB 3x8; Chest-supported Row 3x8–10; Face Pull 3x12–15; Cable Chop 3x10/side

- Fri Upper B: OHP 5x2 @ 80–82.5%; DB Bench 3x8–10; Seated Row 3x8–10; Pulldown 3x10–12; Lateral Raise 3x12–15; Arms 2–3 sets

- Sun Rest or yoga/mobility
